decisions.quote: TEM and SEM images of different ETD nanoformulations; (a) N-Phsoms, (b) P-Phsoms, (c) NLCs, and (d) AlgNPs.
decisions.reason: Fig. 1A includes SEM images of the ETD-loaded nanoformulations (1 um scale bar), so an SEM variant row for loaded particles is supported; A omitted it.

decisions.quote: SEM (B) and TEM (C) were used to visualize Cu@DHPs, Au@OVA@Cu@DHPs, CaO2-Au@OVA@Cu@DHPs, and P-CaO2-Au@OVA@Cu@DHPs NPs.
decisions.reason: SEM panel also shows CaO2-Au@OVA@Cu@DHPs, a precursor of the final NP; text describes its somewhat cube-like morphology. Intermediate SEM row is supported.

decisions.quote: The size and PDI of P-CaO2-Au@OVA@Cu@DHPs NPs in an aqueous solution were assessed via DLS.
decisions.reason: Only the 157.2 nm measurement has a stated medium. The day-28 stability size (186.2 nm) has no medium stated (medio_no_declarado), so A's extra nd row is not useful.

decisions.quote: The samples were diluted (1:100) in a 1 mM KCl aqueous solution and placed in the electrophoretic cell
decisions.location: Methods > 2.3.1 Mean Size, Polydispersity Index and Zeta Potential Analysis
decisions.reason: Both passes agree on medium (1 mM KCl, pH ~4.5) and identities (empty and loaded); they differ only in label wording. B's wording matches the Methods text.
